blocks.source: ｸﾘｱ日
blocks.translation: Clear Date

blocks.source: 質量／物語
blocks.translation: Weight / Story

blocks.source: ３２時間でクリア。ＰＳ３からのダウンロードで今更ながらプレイしてみた。
blocks.translation: Cleared it in 32 hours. I played it via a download on the PS3, belatedly giving it a try.

blocks.source: クロノトリガーの続編。関連性は非常に強いので前作をプレイしていないと意味不明になる。……というか、難解なのでプレイしていても意味不明になるかも。
blocks.translation: A sequel to Chrono Trigger. The connection is extremely strong, so it will make no sense if you have not played the previous game. ...Actually, it may be hard to understand even if you have played it, since the story is so difficult to follow.

blocks.source: クロノトリガーといえばタイムトラベル。タイムトラベルといえば密接に関わってくるのがパラレルワールド。
blocks.translation: When you think of Chrono Trigger, you think of time travel. And when you think of time travel, parallel worlds are closely involved.

blocks.source: クロノトリガーではパラレルワールドは扱わなかったが、クロノクロスはそのパラレルワールドに軸足を移した物語になっている。
blocks.translation: Chrono Trigger did not deal with parallel worlds, but Chrono Cross is a story centered around them.

blocks.source: そして、パラレルワールドものの例に漏れずストーリーは難解。トリガーよりもずっとＳＦ色が強い。開発者がゼノギアスともかぶっているので、ストーリー・システム共に影響が見られる。
blocks.translation: As is typical of stories involving parallel worlds, the plot is difficult to follow. It has a much stronger science-fiction flavor than Trigger. Since some of the developers also worked on Xenogears, their influence can be seen in both the story and the systems.

blocks.source: トリガーの続編としてはマニアック過ぎる嫌いもあるけれど、壮大で作りこまれていることは確か。
blocks.translation: It may be too esoteric for a sequel to Trigger, but there is no doubt that it is epic and meticulously crafted.

blocks.source: 仲間が多数登場。ただし、重要度の低いキャラもたくさんいる。……なんだか幻想水滸伝チック。
blocks.translation: Many companions appear. However, there are also plenty of characters with little importance. ...Somehow, it feels a bit like Suikoden.

blocks.source: ストーリー主導のゲームにしては、重要度が低いキャラクターのエピソードが多数あったり、『６体の竜を倒せ』といった寄り道があったりで、進行が遅いところも。そのせいもあってか、後半に怒涛の世界設定に関する説明が入る。
blocks.translation: For a story-driven game, progress can be slow because it contains many episodes involving characters of little importance, as well as detours such as “Defeat the six dragons.” Perhaps because of this, a torrent of explanations about the world setting comes in the latter half.

blocks.source: ラストバトル中の行動次第で、グッドエンディングになるが、条件が難解。
blocks.translation: Depending on your actions during the final battle, you can get the good ending, but the requirements are difficult to figure out.

blocks.source: ヒントは事実上のラストダンジョンにあるけれど、クリアしたら崩れるので、再確認不可能。ネット時代ならなんてことはないけれど、当時のプレイヤーには厳しかったんじゃないだろうか。
blocks.translation: The hints are in what is essentially the final dungeon, but it collapses after you clear it, making them impossible to check again. That would be no problem in the Internet age, but it must have been difficult for players at the time.

blocks.source: 強くてニューゲームが存在。二週目はトリガーと同じで、いつでもラスボスを倒せる。倒すタイミングによって、マルチエンディングになるとか。※筆者は未確認ですが……。
blocks.translation: A New Game+ mode is available. As in Trigger, during the second playthrough you can defeat the final boss at any time. Apparently, the timing of the defeat determines which of the multiple endings you get. ※I have not confirmed this myself, though...

blocks.source: システム／バランス／快適性
blocks.translation: Systems / Balance / Comfort

blocks.source: 戦闘システムが特徴的。これを説明するのはなかなか難しいが、大雑把に箇条書きすると……。
blocks.translation: The battle system is distinctive. It is quite difficult to explain, but here is a rough bullet-point summary...

blocks.source: キャラクターはスタミナがなくなるまで複数回行動可能。
blocks.translation: Characters can act multiple times until they run out of stamina.

blocks.source: どのキャラクターを行動させるか、細かく変更可能。
blocks.translation: You can freely change which character acts, in fine detail.

blocks.source: 弱中強の三種類の攻撃を使い分けて、コンボ可能。
blocks.translation: You can use the three types of attacks—weak, medium, and strong—in combination to perform combos.

blocks.source: 攻撃を当てるとパワーレベルが上昇。エレメント（魔法）を使用可能に。
blocks.translation: Landing attacks raises your power level, allowing you to use Elements (magic).

blocks.source: エレメントは赤青黄緑白黒の６属性に分かれる。仲間も属性がある。
blocks.translation: Elements are divided into six attributes: red, blue, yellow, green, white, and black. Companions also have attributes.

blocks.source: エレメントはキャラクターごとに配置（装備）する。
blocks.translation: Elements are assigned (equipped) to each character.

blocks.source: 使用したエレメントは戦闘中に再使用できない。
blocks.translation: An Element that has been used cannot be used again during the battle.

blocks.source: 使用したエレメントの属性が三つまで戦闘フィールドに残る。
blocks.translation: Up to three attributes of used Elements remain on the battle field.

blocks.source: 場に残った属性と同じ属性の威力が高まり、その後の戦闘に影響を与える。
blocks.translation: The power of attributes matching those remaining on the field increases, affecting subsequent battles.

blocks.source: 場の属性はロマサガなどにあったものを、よりはっきりとしたシステムとしたようなものと考えればよさげ。後の市販＆フリゲＲＰＧにもこの種のシステムを見ることがあるけれど、派生元と言ってよいかもしれない。
blocks.translation: The field attributes seem to be a more clearly defined version of something found in games such as Romancing SaGa. You can find this kind of system in later commercial and freeware RPGs, so it may be fair to call this its source.

blocks.source: 個人的にもこういう属性系のシステムはいつかやってみたいと思っていたり。
blocks.translation: Personally, I have also wanted to try making a system based on attributes like this someday.

blocks.source: 戦闘終了後に残ったエレメントでＨＰを自動回復してくれる機能があって便利。実質、ザコ戦でのＨＰ消費はほとんど気にしなくともよい。
blocks.translation: There is a convenient feature that automatically restores HP after battle using the Elements left over. In practice, you barely need to worry about HP consumption in battles against regular enemies.

blocks.source: レベルアップのためには、ボス戦に勝つ必要があるのも大きな特徴。ザコ敵を倒しても経験値は手に入らないし、レベルアップもしない。時折、難易度が高いところがあるけれど、レベルを上げてのゴリ押しは難しい。ザコ戦でも、多少は能力上昇するものの、やはり制限があるようで期待できない。
blocks.translation: Another major feature is that you need to win boss battles to level up. Defeating regular enemies yields no experience, and you do not level up. The difficulty is occasionally high, but it is hard to brute-force your way through by grinding levels. Regular battles do raise your abilities slightly, but there seem to be limits, so you cannot rely on them.

blocks.source: ともかく戦闘システムはなかなか作りこまれてる。どうエレメントを活用するかで、大きく形勢が変化するので戦術性も高い。
blocks.translation: In any case, the battle system is quite intricately designed. Since the battle situation can change dramatically depending on how you use your Elements, it also offers a high degree of tactical depth.

blocks.source: ……がしかし、戦闘テンポは遅く、ロード時間は長い。加えて、ラストバトルがイベントバトル気味なので、戦闘の面白さを求めると物足りなさを感じてしまう。
blocks.translation: ...But the battle tempo is slow, and loading times are long. In addition, the final battle is somewhat like an event battle, so those seeking engaging battles may find it unsatisfying.

blocks.source: 戦闘開始に１０秒。
blocks.translation: Ten seconds to start a battle.

blocks.source: 戦闘終了は結果表示まで含めて１５秒。
blocks.translation: Fifteen seconds to finish a battle, including displaying the results.

blocks.source: エレメントを使う度に５～１５秒。
blocks.translation: Five to fifteen seconds every time you use an Element.

blocks.source: こちらのコンボに敵が割り込んでくるので流れが止まる。
blocks.translation: Enemies interrupt your combos, bringing the flow to a halt.

blocks.source: というか、敵にターンが回るタイミングがよく分からず、ルールが不明瞭。
blocks.translation: Actually, it is difficult to tell when it becomes the enemy's turn, making the rules unclear.

blocks.source: モーションが遅い敵だと、通常攻撃だけで５秒。
blocks.translation: Against an enemy with slow animations, even a normal attack takes five seconds.

blocks.source: エレメントの配置は数が多い上に、操作性が悪いので手間。
blocks.translation: Assigning Elements is tedious because there are so many of them and the controls are poor.

blocks.source: 仲間を変更して、再配置する時はさらに手間。
blocks.translation: Changing companions and assigning their Elements again is even more tedious.

blocks.source: 回避困難な戦闘が多い。進行上強制だったり、道が狭かったり。
blocks.translation: There are many battles that are difficult to avoid, either because they are mandatory for progression or because the paths are narrow.

blocks.source: 特に『村中の魔物を全て倒せ』というイベントは、苦行を積んでいるような気分になった。
blocks.translation: In particular, the event that tells you to “Defeat every monster in the village” felt like I was undergoing ascetic training.

blocks.source: この時期のスクウェア作品だとＦＦ８～９もテンポが悪いけれど、その二作よりも一戦闘は長い。戦闘以外も全体的にとろい。１．５～２倍速ぐらいでプレイできたらちょうどいいんじゃないかと思ってしまうほどに。
blocks.translation: Among Square's games from this period, FF8–9 also have poor pacing, but battles here take even longer than in those two games. Everything outside of battle is sluggish as well—so much so that I found myself thinking it would be just right if I could play at around 1.5–2× speed.

blocks.source: ……と、思いきや倍速モードがあるらしい。ただし、二週目以降限定で。それは一周目から欲しかった。
blocks.translation: …Or so I thought, but apparently there is a fast-forward mode. However, it is limited to the second playthrough onward. I wanted that from the first playthrough.

blocks.source: 幸いシンボルエンカウントかつ、さほどエンカウント率が高いわけではない。ダンジョンもそれほど長くないので、どうにかクリアを断念せずに済んだ。
blocks.translation: Fortunately, it uses symbol encounters, and the encounter rate is not particularly high. The dungeons are not especially long either, so I somehow managed to clear the game without giving up.

blocks.source: 取り逃し要素は多め。特にレナやグレンといった比較的有力な仲間を、知らなかったら取り逃す可能性大。
blocks.translation: There are quite a lot of missable elements. In particular, if you do not know about them beforehand, you are very likely to miss relatively powerful party members such as Rena and Glenn.

blocks.source: 美術
blocks.translation: Art

blocks.source: 周知の通り、キャラデザは鳥山明ではなくなってしまった。
blocks.translation: As everyone knows, the character designs are no longer by Akira Toriyama.

blocks.source: マップは多彩で美しい。一部のダンジョンは下手なＰＳ２のＲＰＧにも負けない。
blocks.translation: The maps are varied and beautiful. Some of the dungeons can even hold their own against mediocre PS2 RPGs.

blocks.source: 戦闘アニメは豊富。ただし、この時期によくある「グラフィック偏重で快適性を顧みないゲーム」だと言われたら反論できないけれど。
blocks.translation: There are plenty of battle animations. However, I could not really argue if someone called it “one of those games from this period that prioritizes graphics while neglecting comfort and playability.”

blocks.source: ボス敵の倒れ方がいちいち凝っていることに、グラフィック班のこだわりが見られる。
blocks.translation: The elaborate way each boss enemy falls when defeated shows how particular the graphics team was.

blocks.source: 音楽
blocks.translation: Music

blocks.source: 何と言ってもオープニングテーマの『時の傷跡』が有名。歴代ゲーム音楽でも一番好きな曲としてしょっちゅう名前が挙がる。
blocks.translation: The opening theme, “Time's Scar,” is famous above all. It is frequently mentioned as someone's favorite song in the history of video game music.

blocks.source: 戦闘曲がやや手薄な印象。
blocks.translation: The battle music feels somewhat lacking.

blocks.source: イベント曲をそのままボス戦で流すことが多い。実質的にボス戦曲は二つだけというのはちょっと物足りないか。
blocks.translation: Event tracks are often played as-is during boss battles. Having effectively only two boss battle themes feels a little insufficient.

blocks.source: まとめ
blocks.translation: Summary

blocks.source: 実はかつて体験版をプレイした当時は、かなりのスクウェア信者だったにも関わらず。『戦闘はテンポ悪いし、システムよく分からんし』と感じて購入を見送った。
blocks.translation: In fact, when I played the demo back then, I was quite the Square fanatic. Even so, I decided not to buy it because I felt, “The battles have terrible pacing, and I don't really understand the system.”

blocks.source: 十何年と経ってから、ＰＳ３のダウンロード購入でようやくプレイした次第。
blocks.translation: I finally played it over a decade later, after buying the digital version for the PS3.

blocks.source: その結果、思ったより戦闘システムは好印象。ただしテンポの悪さはかつての記憶そのまんま。
blocks.translation: As a result, I found the battle system more appealing than I expected. However, the poor pacing was exactly as I remembered it.

blocks.source: ※実際には体験版時点より多少は改善しているらしいです。
blocks.translation: ※Apparently, it was actually improved somewhat compared to the demo version.

blocks.source: クロノトリガーのテンポがよかっただけに、これじゃあ受けないよなあ……と今更ながら思ってしまう。
blocks.translation: Chrono Trigger had such good pacing that even now I find myself thinking, “Of course this wasn't going to catch on…”

texts.戦闘アニメは豊富。ただし、この時期によくある「グラフィック偏重で快適性を顧みない: There are plenty of battle animations. However, I could not really argue if someone called it “one of those games from this period that prioritizes graphics while neglecting comfort and playability.”
texts.ボス敵の倒れ方がいちいち凝っていることに、グラフィック班のこだわりが見られる。: The elaborate way each boss enemy falls when defeated shows how particular the graphics team was.
texts.何と言ってもオープニングテーマの『時の傷跡』が有名。歴代ゲーム音楽でも一番好きな: The opening theme, “Time's Scar,” is famous above all. It is frequently mentioned as someone's favorite song in the history of video game music.
texts.戦闘曲がやや手薄な印象。: The battle music feels somewhat lacking.
texts.イベント曲をそのままボス戦で流すことが多い。実質的にボス戦曲は二つだけというのは: Event tracks are often played as-is during boss battles. Having effectively only two boss battle themes feels a little insufficient.
texts.実はかつて体験版をプレイした当時は、かなりのスクウェア信者だったにも関わらず。『: In fact, when I played the demo back then, I was quite the Square fanatic. Even so, I decided not to buy it because I felt, “The battles have terrible pacing, and I don't really understand the system.”
texts.十何年と経ってから、ＰＳ３のダウンロード購入でようやくプレイした次第。: I finally played it over a decade later, after buying the digital version for the PS3.
texts.その結果、思ったより戦闘システムは好印象。ただしテンポの悪さはかつての記憶そのま: As a result, I found the battle system more appealing than I expected. However, the poor pacing was exactly as I remembered it.
texts.※実際には体験版時点より多少は改善しているらしいです。: ※Apparently, it was actually improved somewhat compared to the demo version.
texts.クロノトリガーのテンポがよかっただけに、これじゃあ受けないよなあ……と今更ながら: Chrono Trigger had such good pacing that even now I find myself thinking, “Of course this wasn't going to catch on…”
